metadata.Description:
Rollback Procedures
1. Implement blue-green deployment strategies to enable quick rollbacks if issues are detected.
2. Use Istio for advanced deployment strategies and automated canary analysis.
3. Maintain versioned backups of critical data and configurations to support rollbacks.
